units.source_text: 孩子气的我，虽然离开了故乡，心里仍旧希望故乡有个让我依恋的家。

en.t: Childish as I was, even after leaving my hometown, I still wished in my heart that there would be a home there for me to long for.

units.source_text: 我是以游子之心渴望着，家乡还有自己可以回归的家园。

en.t: I longed for it with the heart of a wanderer, believing that in my hometown there was still a home to which I could return.

units.source_text: 无论多么喜欢东京而离开家乡，一放假就必须回家的心情依然非常强烈。

en.t: No matter how much I liked Tokyo and had left my hometown, the feeling that I must go home as soon as vacation came remained very strong.

units.source_text: 在专心学习、愉快游玩之余，我常常梦见放假时就可以回去的故乡的家。

en.t: Between studying hard and playing happily, I often dreamed of the home in my hometown to which I could return during vacation.

units.source_text: 我不知道在我离家期间，叔叔是怎样两地跑的。

en.t: I do not know how my uncle went back and forth between the two places while I was away from home.

units.source_text: 我回到家的时候，他的家人全都住在这座宅子里。

en.t: When I returned home, his whole family was living in this house.

units.source_text: 上学的孩子大概平时住在城里，放假后，为了也让他们到乡下来玩玩，才带回来的。

en.t: The children who attended school probably usually lived in town, and after vacation began they were brought back so they could spend some time playing in the countryside too.
Everyone was happy to see me.

units.source_text: 我看到家里比父母在世时反而更加热闹，更有生气，也感到很快活。

en.t: Seeing the house livelier and more spirited than it had been when my parents were alive made me feel happy too.

units.source_text: 叔叔把占了我房间的大小子轰出去，让我住进去。

en.t: My uncle drove out the older boy who had taken over my room and put me in it instead.

units.source_text: 家里的空房还有不少，我推让了一番，说自己住别的屋子也可以。

en.t: There were still quite a few empty rooms in the house, so I demurred and said that another room would be fine for me.

units.source_text: 但是叔叔不答应，说‘这是你的家呀’。

en.t: But my uncle would not agree, saying, This is your home.
